## Workload

Lena Fischer completed 756 reads during 330 hours of grading activity. This represents an average rate of 2.3 reads per hour. The workload information provides a clear record of the volume completed and the time allocated to the work. The reported rate offers a straightforward basis for reviewing workload expectations and understanding the relationship between reading volume and hours worked.

## Quality

A further 55 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement rate was 76.4. Priya Anand completed the review and considered the checked work against the grading outcome. Together, the workload and checking results provide a concise view of activity and quality for the period. The information should be retained as the review record for this grading activity.
